evidence.note: Current official CLO DXF guide checked against prior actual controls. No new safe, documented point-retention setting exists; Remove Non-Grading Points explicitly deletes ungraded points and was not tested. No UI/file operation occurred. V03 gates unchanged.

text: S522 closes the current CLO control screen without another UI operation. S503 curve-optimization variants and S519 Draw Curve Points did not fix the measured Polo loss. The remaining documented Remove Non-Grading Points option deletes points without grade information and is not a safe fix for the ungraded input. Do not repeat these settings; require a new source-backed mechanism plus rights evidence before another CLO trial.
